name: 5-Level Per-Channel BitLinear
tagline: Quantizes weights to {-1,-1/2,0,1/2,1} with per-output-row absmax scaling, drops activation quantization entirely, and rescales after the matmul.
formula:
$$s_o = \max_i |W_{o,i}|,\quad u_{o,i} = W_{o,i}/s_o$$
$$\hat{W}_{o,i} = \tfrac{1}{2}\,\mathrm{round}(2\,\mathrm{clip}(u_{o,i}, -1, 1)) \in \{-1,-\tfrac{1}{2},0,\tfrac{1}{2},1\}$$
$$y_o = s_o \cdot \sum_i \hat{W}_{o,i}\,x_i + b_o\quad(\text{STE on round})$$
init_recovers: binary_sign-like behavior at heavy clipping; no clean baseline equivalent
diff_from_baseline: Differs from int2_uniform (4 levels, absmean per-tensor + activation quant) by using 5 levels with per-row absmax scaling and removing 8-bit activation quantization altogether.

name: Per-Channel Ternary + Clipped STE
tagline: BitNet b1.58 with per-output-channel absmean scaling and a custom autograd masking gradients of weights outside the [-1,1] normalized range.
formula:
$$s_o = \mathrm{mean}_i\,|W_{o,i}|,\ u_{o,i} = W_{o,i}/s_o,\ \hat{W}_{o,i} = \mathrm{round}(\mathrm{clip}(u_{o,i}, -1, 1))$$
$$y = (W_q\,x_q)\odot (s\cdot s_x),\quad \nabla_W \mathcal{L} = \nabla_{W_q}\mathcal{L}\,\cdot\,\frac{\mathbb{1}[|u|\le 1]}{s}$$
$$\text{(activations: per-tensor int8 absmax + STE round)}$$
init_recovers: ternary_158bit baseline up to per-channel scale and clipped STE
diff_from_baseline: Two changes vs ternary_158bit: per-output-channel absmean scaling instead of per-tensor, and a custom autograd Function whose backward zeros gradients on weights with |W/s|>1 (no straight-through past the clipping rail).

name: L2-Optimal Ternary + Token-LSQ Activations
tagline: Mean-centred per-channel ternary weights with a least-squares-fitted scale per row, paired with int8 activations whose per-token scale is also LSQ-optimal; trained without weight decay.
init_recovers: ternary_158bit when LSQ scale equals absmean and centering is zero
diff_from_baseline: Centers each output row before quantization, replaces absmean scale with a per-row LSQ-optimal scale that minimizes ||W - s*Q||^2, and applies the same LSQ idea per-token to int8 activations. Also disables AdamW weight decay.

name: Groupwise Ternary + RMS-Clipped Activations
tagline: Centered, group-of-64 ternary weights with adaptive dead-zone tau and a 0.6 LSQ + 0.4 variance-match row scale; activations clipped between 0.7*absmax and 2.8*RMS before int8.

key_hyperparams.name: row scale mix
key_hyperparams.role: blend of LSQ and variance-matching scales

init_recovers: ternary_158bit when tau=0.5 and groups span the full row
diff_from_baseline: Replaces the single global absmean threshold of ternary_158bit with row-centered, group-of-64 ternary with adaptive dead-zone tau driven by rms/mean ratio, a blended (LSQ + variance-match) row scale, and per-token int8 activations whose clip is RMS-aware rather than pure absmax.

name: RMS-Scaled Ternary BitLinear
tagline: BitNet b1.58 with per-tensor RMS scale (sqrt(mean(W^2))) instead of absmean; activations stay 8-bit absmax.
init_recovers: ternary_158bit (matches it modulo absmean -> RMS factor of ~sqrt(pi/2))
diff_from_baseline: Single-line change to ternary_158bit: replaces the per-tensor absmean scale (E[|W|]) with the per-tensor RMS scale (sqrt(E[W^2])); the rest of the pipeline (ternary {-1,0,1}, int8 absmax activations, STE) is unchanged.
